name: Apostates
overview: Scripture warns that in the latter days, some will fall away from the faith, influenced by deceptive spirits and false doctrines, as described in 1 Timothy 4:1-2. Those who initially receive the word with joy but lack deep roots are prone to fall away under temptation, as Luke 8:13 illustrates. Zephaniah 1:6 highlights those who turn back from the Lord and fail to seek Him, emphasizing the serious spiritual danger of apostasy.
